P. 2</ls>; तन्नाम येनाभिदधाति सत्त्वम्. .³({%c%}) To speak or say to, address. .²2 To name, call, designate; usually in {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} (-धीयते); इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते <ls>Bg. 13. 1</ls>. .²3 To lay or put on, fasten, bind; to overlay, load; assail; receive, comprehend, include; to draw oneself towards, hold, support (mostly <ab>Ved.</ab> in these senses.)

अभिधा {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> Naming; praised, invoked. अभिधा असि भुवनमसि यन्तासि धर्ता <ls>Vāj. 22. 3</ls>. {%n.%} .²1 A name, appellation; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>; कुसुमवसन्ताद्यभिधः <ls>S. D.</ls> .²2 A word, sound. .²3 The literal power or sense of a word, {%denotation%}, one of the three powers of a word; वाच्योऽर्थोऽभिधया बोध्यः <ls>S. D. 2</ls>. “the expressed meaning is that which is conveyed to the understanding by the wordʼs denotation”, for it is this अभिधा that conveys to the understanding the meaning which belongs to the word by common consent or convention (संकेत) (which primarily made it a word at all); स मुख्योऽर्थस्तत्र मुख्यो यो व्यापारोऽस्याभिधोच्यते <ls>K. P. 2</ls>.
